description: Lean MORe kernel. One invariant organises everything: every artifact is held exactly once; everything else is a pointer or a lossless, regenerable projection. Relations, gates, lifecycle and profiles are layered on the four core primitives.

invariant.statement: Every artifact exists exactly once, at one leading place, under one stable id. Anything else that shows its content is either a pointer to artifact@version or a declared projection that can be regenerated from its sources without loss. A hand-maintained copy or a reinterpretation that drops properties is a violation, not a feature.

quotes.text: Eine Spezifikation. Viele Ableitungen. Keine zweite Wahrheit. ... Fachliche Regeln werden einmal gefuehrt.
jede Information genau einmal und am richtigen Ort. Dokumente sind Sichten auf Informationen, nicht ihr Speicherort.
Jede fachliche Information wird genau einmal definiert, versioniert, entschieden und mit ihren Ableitungen verbunden.
[Repraesentationen] duerfen nicht unabhaengig voneinander zu neuen Wahrheiten werden.
Eine Spezifikation. Viele erzeugte Repraesentationen. Eine eigenstaendig evolvierbare Implementierung. Aber keine zweite Wahrheit.
Das Gegenmittel ist nicht mehr Dokumentation. Das Gegenmittel ist weniger doppelte Information.
Dokumente und andere Publikationsformen werden aus gefuehrten Informationen erzeugt oder referenzieren sie, statt eine zweite Wahrheit zu bilden.
Eine Ableitung ist nur dann belastbar, wenn die fuer ihren Zweck relevanten fachlichen Invarianten erhalten bleiben und dies ueberpruefbar ist.
Beziehungen statt Kopien ... Publikationen ... aus dem aktuellen Informationsstand erzeugt - nicht separat fortgeschrieben.
Generierte Dateien erhalten einen Versions- und Herkunftsnachweis. Manuelle Aenderungen an generierten Artefakten werden im Build erkannt.

artifact.meaning: The only place content is authored. Single home, stable id, versioned.

fields.id: stable, never reused; PREFIX-NNN for MORe types (IA §8.1), rule/field ids for spec elements (ELSTER §6.1)
fields.home: the leading place (system + locator); exactly one (BEL §3 'fuehrender Ort')
fields.version: monotonic; every content change creates a new version
fields.content: authored payload; only present at home

rules: no two artifacts may carry the same content-bearing field for the same fact (detect by content hash / declared fact keys)
an artifact held in an external system (git, GitHub, model registry) is NOT copied in; the board holds a pointer

shape.text: PLZ und Ort muessen zueinander passen

field_rules: separate meaning, type, optionality, dependencies and technical serialization (ELSTER Phase B, §7.3)

technical restrictions (e.g. xs:sequence order) are held as a technical derivation attribute (serializationOrder), never mixed into the business rule (ELSTER §7.3: 'Technische Restriktionen duerfen die Fachsemantik beeinflussen, aber sie duerfen sie nicht ersetzen')
preserve information states: absent != 'null' != 0.00 (ELSTER §2.2, §8.1); normalisation must not destroy them

pointer.meaning: Reference to artifact@version. Carries no content of its target. A pointer is how one artifact uses another.

fields.target_version: pinned version / commit sha / revision; 'floating' only allowed for navigation pointers and must be marked
fields.valid_to: timestamp or null; ending a pointer is a recorded change, never a hard delete

rules: an unpinned pointer claims every version of A fits every version of B (BEL §9) - only nav pointers may float
a pointer whose target version is superseded becomes 'suspect' until re-confirmed
pointer.src: BEL §9 'Ein Link ohne Versionsbezug behauptet stillschweigend, dass jede Fassung von A zu jeder Fassung von B passt.'

projection.meaning: A declared, pure function of source artifacts at pinned versions: a view (Sicht). Views, caches, indexes, counts and mirrors are projections. Generated XSD/API schemas, validators and generated tests are derivatives, not projections (core_primitives.derivative; C21, more-lean-model.md §15). Generated documentation (reference, API docs, field catalogue) is a projection, a Publikationssicht (BEL §5.2); manuals and handbooks are derivatives; prose-written specs are sources (core_primitives.derivative.documentation_split; ruling C21 Q6).

fields.preserves: list of properties that must survive (invariants), e.g. meaning, type, optionality, ordering, completeness
fields.provenance: sources + function version embedded in output

rules: pure: same sources@versions + same function version => same output
regenerable: may be deleted and rebuilt at any time with no information loss
never hand-edited: edits go to the source artifact, then the projection is regenerated (ELSTER §13)
lossy is allowed only if declared: dropped properties must not be in 'preserves', and the projection must not be used where they matter
a projection cannot be the source of another artifact's content; only of other projections

derivable_set.excluded: application code ('model-driven bei der Spezifikation, nicht generator-driven bei der Implementierung')
derivable_set.moved_to_derivative: xsd_or_json_schema, validators_with_stable_rule_ids and tests_and_boundary_tests moved to core_primitives.derivative.derivable_set (C21, 2026-10-27). The remaining kinds stay projections. Ruling C21 Q6 confirms it for generated documentation: field_catalogue_and_rule_docs and the release docs are Publikationssichten (BEL §5.2), not derivatives.
derivable_set.note: 'Generieren heisst: Eine erzeugte Repraesentation darf nicht manuell zur zweiten Wahrheit werden.'

ordering_example.text: XML generator sorts deterministically by serializationOrder; XSD sequence is a projection property, not business semantics

derivative.meaning: An Ableitung: an artifact derived from a source (spec element or IR) at a pinned version that is a typed interpretation, not a view. It hangs on its source through derives_from (inverse derives_into) with preserves[] per purpose. It has a required mode: generated (validators, generated tests, XSD/API schemas, generated target code) or authored (written by a person from pinned sources). Manuals and handbooks may be either mode. Application code is not a derivative (implementation, linked by implements).

fields.source: generated: pointer to source@version (spec element or IR@hash) via derives_from
fields.profile: generated: target profile@version, when the generator takes one
fields.output_hash: generated: hash of the output as generated
fields.author: authored: the person who wrote it (required)
fields.sources: authored: the pinned sources@versions it was written from (at least one; replaces generator@version)
fields.preserves: on the derives_from edge: (purpose, invariant) pairs that must hold in the output

rules: pure (generated): same source@version + generator@version + profile@version => same output
never hand-edited (generated): edits go to the source, then the derivative is generated again (ELSTER Phase D, §11.2)

authored: written by its author from pinned sources@versions; a superseded pinned source makes it stale (derivative_stale), and its preserves[] are checked like a generated one (derivative_drops_preserved)
lossy is allowed only if declared: a dropped invariant must not be in preserves for that purpose

a run of a derivative (validator, test) is not a new kind: it yields a verification event (the verdict) pinned to source@v and derivative@v; that event is the evidence for the derivation claim of the edge. No separate Gate kind (C21 ruling 1)

derivable_set.src: ELSTER §6.2; MP p.6 (XSD as typed interpretation)
derivable_set.note: generated_target_code is generated output of a target profile (agents-design targets), not application code; ELSTER §6.3 excludes application code from generation. manuals_and_handbooks: ruling C21 Q6 (see documentation_split). manuals_and_handbooks may be generated or authored (Fabian, 2026-10-27); the other kinds have mode generated.

documentation_split.ruling: C21 Q6 (Fabian, 2026-10-27, relayed via klanker): 'docs sind ja die prose written specs, actual documentation are projections, manuals/handbooks are derivates'

prose_spec.meaning: a prose-written spec (e.g. a repo's docs/ calculus or concept text) is MORe source material: an artifact held once at its home, edited there, pointed to. It is neither generated nor regenerable.
prose_spec.src: BEL §5.1 (Abb. 4: 'Die strukturierte Feldspezifikation ist der fuehrende Informationsbestand fuer Mapping, Regeln und Ableitungen'); ELSTER §1, §13; ruling C21 Q6

generated_documentation.meaning: a view of the sources at pinned versions: pure, regenerable, never hand-edited, no preserves[] beyond the projection rules
generated_documentation.src: BEL §5.2 'API-Dokumentation, Feldkatalog, Prueflogiken und Anwenderdokumentation sind Publikationssichten, keine parallel gepflegten Wahrheiten'; IA §6, §14.3 ('Dokumente sind dort ausdruecklich Sichten auf Inhalte'); ELSTER §6.2; ruling C21 Q6

manual.meaning: a purpose-shaped interpretation of the sources, not a view: a derivative, generated or authored. It hangs on its sources through derives_from with preserves[] per purpose. A derives_from edge without preserves is preserves_missing. Both modes: derivative_stale, derivative_drops_preserved. Generated: also generated_provenance_missing, derivative_hand_edited. Authored: also authored_provenance_missing.
manual.src: ruling C21 Q6 (Fabian's decision, 2026-10-27, both modes; no MORe source, see core_primitives.derivative.modes.source_search). Context: BEL §5.1 'Eine fachliche Regel wird nicht zusaetzlich in Feldkatalog, Codekommentar, Testbeschreibung und Handbuch gepflegt'; IA §14.3 (a MORe hierarchy is 'eine ideale Quelle fuer topic-basierte Anwenderdokumentation'; Diataxis: Tutorial, Anleitung, Referenz, Erklaerung)

divergence.source_text: API-Dokumentation, Feldkatalog, Prueflogiken und Anwenderdokumentation sind Publikationssichten, keine parallel gepflegten Wahrheiten.
divergence.also: US §8 lists Anwenderdokumentation and Online-Hilfe among the Sichten generated from one Informationsbestand
divergence.kernel_rule: manuals and handbooks are derivatives (derives_from with preserves[]), not Publikationssichten. Reference-style generated documentation stays a projection as BEL §5.2 says.
divergence.deviation: BEL §5.2 puts Anwenderdokumentation with the projections; the kernel puts manuals and handbooks (user and operations handbooks, tutorials, how-to guidance) with the derivatives. Fabian's decision wins over the source text. No source text names manuals as derivatives or an authored mode (modes.source_search); both are Fabian's decision (2026-10-27).

documentation_split.purpose: no MORe source names a purpose for manuals (searched: MP C.1, BEL §5, IA §6 and §14.3, US §8, ELSTER §6). purpose_register.profiles.agents_design registers manual as a profile addition with typed provenance, approved by Fabian on 2026-10-27 (approval.status approved; more-lean-model.md §12d).

derivative.src: BEL v1.2 §7.2 ('Sichten, Ableitungen, Umsetzung, Nachweise ...'), §5.2.1, §10.2; MP p.6, p.6-7 (B.2); ELSTER §1, §6, §10 Phase D, §11.2; ruling C21 (Fabian, 2026-10-27)

examples: generated manual or handbook (e.g. step-by-step manuals generated from procedures)

modes.board: The board (the 'author view of MORe') stays a projection: it is a pure fold over events, and authoring on it emits events. Authoring there does not make the board an authored derivative.

source_search.searched: /workspace/more/pdf: ELSTER v1.2, BEL v1.2, MP, ZOHO V8.0, US (DE, EN), IA v1.4
source_search.found: No source names an authored derivative mode, or manuals that must preserve invariants. BEL v1.2 §5.2.1 (text l.262-270) and §10.2 (l.951-955) ask for preserved invariants whenever a spec element is transferred into 'ein XSD, eine Validatorregel, eine Implementierung oder einen Testfall' and for 'Ableitungs-, Implementierungs- und Nachweisbeziehungen'. An Implementierung is not generated (ELSTER §6.3, l.322-340), so the sources tie invariant preservation to the transfer, not to generation. That supports derivative_drops_preserved for both modes; it does not source the authored mode or manuals as derivatives.
source_search.tension: ELSTER §10 (l.505-512) treats manually maintained copies as something to replace by Ableitungen step by step; BEL §5.1 (l.248-249) says a rule is not maintained again in the Handbuch. An authored derivative keeps no own copy of a rule: it points at pinned sources and is checked by preserves[].
source_search.label: mode=authored, 'manuals are derivatives' and 'manuals in both modes' are Fabian's decision (2026-10-27, C21 Q6); BEL §5.2 deviation: see documentation_split.divergence

modes.manuals: Manuals and handbooks may be either mode: generated or authored (Fabian, 2026-10-27, t218u: 'manual is well generated/authored manuals/handbooks'). The drift ids of the manual's mode apply.

drift_check.meaning: Mechanical test that the invariant holds. Any violation fails CI / blocks the gate.

validation_stages.src: ELSTER §9 (six stages, all tied to the same spec element/rule ids)
stages: source_and_mapping (absent/null/value classified; each source column -> exactly one field)
business_plausibility (paired fields, conditional, Kz10 null rules)

regression_golden_files (versioned valid/invalid examples; spec change yields artifact diff)
validation_stages.rule: a production-accepted example file is not a hidden spec; it becomes a regression test with known provenance and scope (ELSTER §9)

impact_analysis.text: changing a rule yields the concrete affected chain (spec section, story, test cases, release evidence -> 're-check'), not a list of possibly stale documents

runtime_divergence.text: accepted runtime behaviour may diverge from strict local validation (Kz84/85 order accepted for months, rejected by xmllint). Record as evidence with result 'objected'/'deviation'; do not 'fix' by copying behaviour into code

event.meaning: An immutable, append-only record that something was decided, verified, included, superseded, overruled or moved. Events are the only write path for state changes; artifact state, pointer validity, status and PR/issue views are projections (folds) over events.

envelope.id: content hash or minted id; never reused
envelope.actor: DID of the asserting party; on_behalf_of for agents
envelope.pinned_against: artifact@version / commit / baseline the claim was made against (required)
envelope.supersedes: link(s) to superseded event or artifact@version

rules: no update, no delete: ending anything is an event
supersession/overrule must link superseded item@version

projections.issue_view: fold over events with subject=issue: open decisions, latest verification per check, inclusions, supersession chain
projections.pr_view: projection of one inclusion event (into, from-range) + verifications pinned to its head; description generated, not authored

relations.note: Every relation is a typed pointer (version-pinned). Relations never copy target content.

source_quotes.de: Informationen werden nicht bei jedem Übergang neu beschrieben. Stattdessen werden bestehende Objekte referenziert, verfeinert, ergänzt oder in Beziehung gesetzt.
Die Organisation definiert, welche Informationsobjekte existieren, welchen Zweck sie haben und welche Beziehungen zulässig oder erforderlich sind.
Jede Ebene beantwortet genau eine fachliche Frage – und ergänzt den vorherigen Informationsstand, ohne ihn zu wiederholen.
Die Hierarchie beschreibt den Weg einer Anforderung – von der fachlichen Idee bis zur abgenommenen, produktiven Lösung.
Die vollständige Link-Semantik ist bewusst nicht Gegenstand dieses Whitepapers.
Beziehungskatalog muss noch normiert und operationalisiert werden.
Führend ist das Spezifikationselement selbst: mit eindeutiger ID, Bedeutung, Datentyp, Optionalität, Serialisierungsregel, Abhängigkeiten und Akzeptanzkriterien.

refines.kernel_rule: Kernel fixes pointer shape: pinned target, meaning on preserves[] (purpose refines: detail_existing | toward_target), no superseded target (pointer_suspect), profile kind-pair rule, and for detail_existing an IA-only level guard when both ends are hierarchy levels (Level in More/Hierarchy.lean; UI and API same rank; decision and spec corpus excluded). Default pairs: any known kind to any other known kind; same kind refused (refines_pair_not_in_profile). Profile override: refinesAllowedPairs whitelist and/or refinesAllowSameKind. Ruling: Fabian, chat, 2026-11-03.
open_questions_superseded: Which artifact kinds may be the source or target of a refines pointer? PI names the verb but not endpoint kinds. BEL §7.2 lists Entscheidung, Risiko, Umsetzung and Nachweis; it does not list Verfeinerung.

Should refines target only leading-spec kinds (need, requirement, spec_element, rule) as DoR already accepts refines toward the leading spec (MAN DoR, Ready.pointsToSpec), or may it target hierarchy nodes (UC, BP, CM, …)?
Does refines follow the IA §9.1 path (Anforderung → UC → BP → … → AC) as adjacency on the hierarchy, cross to the ELSTER spec corpus, or both?

Is decision (DEC) a valid refines target? Board issue #24 suggested requirement/decision without a MORe source; BEL operationalises decisions with wird entschieden in / Entscheidung betrifft, not Verfeinerung.

Kernel direction today is source → target (JwfExamples.specPtr: WI-7@1 refines SPEC-3@2). Does that match the German reading of verfeinert, or should elaboration toward the leading spec use references instead?
PI Leitprinzip 1 leaves allowed relations to the organisation. Should endpoint rules live in the kernel or in profile tailoring (BEL §10.3)?

proposed_rule_draft_superseded.note: Do not implement until Fabian rules on the open questions. A plausible shape: refuse refines when the target is not a leading-spec artifact kind; check on assertPointer. That draft is not quoted in PI, BEL §7.2, IA §9 or ELSTER §6.

decisions.text: refines has two meanings with one shape: detail_existing and toward_target (Koru std/refine).
Targets may be leading spec elements and hierarchy nodes (UC, BP, CM, …).
Both: along the IA level path and into the spec corpus.
A decision is a valid target.
WI refines SPEC is a valid reading (typically toward_target).
Profile sets allowed kind pairs; kernel fixes shape only.
detail_existing: when both ends are IA levels, target rank must not be finer than source (UI and API tie); otherwise profile pairs only; toward_target: no extra level rule.
Q1: every refines pointer must state exactly one meaning on preserves[] (refines_meaning_missing); no default when missing.

Q2: default pair rule — any known artifact kind may refine any other known kind; same kind refused; unknown kind refused; profile may override with refines_allowed_pairs and/or refines_allow_same_kind.

meaning_preserves.note: Exactly one meaning entry on preserves[] (same pattern as maps_to + compliance). Lean: refinesPurpose, refinesMeaningFromPreserves in More/Relation.lean.

profile_kind_policy.default_rule: Any resolved known artifact kind may refine any other known kind; same kind refused; unknown kind refused (refines_pair_not_in_profile).

override.note: When refines_allowed_pairs is a list of [sourceKind, targetKind], only those pairs are allowed (full override). refines_allow_same_kind applies only when refines_allowed_pairs is null.

profile_kind_policy.src: Profile.knownRefinesArtifactKinds, Profile.refinesPairAllowed, refinesAllowedPairs, refinesAllowSameKind (More/Profile.lean); tailoring per PI Leitprinzip 1.

violations.fires_when: pointer.type is refines and preserves[] has no exactly-one purpose refines property detail_existing or toward_target
resolved source/target kinds fail the profile refines pair rule (default: unknown kind, or same kind when refines_allow_same_kind is false; whitelist override when refines_allowed_pairs is set)
violations.provenance_ref: more-lean-model.md §16; PI p.5 Leitprinzip 1; BEL §10.3; Fabian chat 2026-11-03

violations.fires_when: meaning is detail_existing and both source and target resolve to IA hierarchy levels (Level; IA §9/§9.1) and target level rank is finer than source (UI and API share rank; DEC/spec/task/mixed pairs do not fire)

derives_from.preserves: required (it is the derivation edge of a derivative, not a projection edge; C21)

derives_into.preserves: required (inverse of derives_from; a separate edge with the matching name)
derives_into.src: MP p.6 'wird repraesentiert durch' (proposed earlier as represented_by); name: ruling C21 (Fabian, 2026-10-27)

implements.preserves: required (checked via tests, not regeneration; code is not a projection)

maps_to.preserves: required; exactly one level and one event_type on preserves[] with purpose compliance (registered purpose); ambiguous, missing, or wrong-purpose entries yield no mapping (generated_projections.compliance_matrix.maps_to_preserves)
maps_to.target: pinned regulation corpus text: subject = regulation label, version = duty_version of the source regulation_requirement; mismatch or floating target is maps_to_target_mismatch

evidence.rule: Evidence is an artifact (authored once) asserting that pointer P between A@x and B@y holds; author, time, method, result. Several may coexist.

claim_types.source: MP p.5-6 (B.0/2): 'Jede Beziehung hat einen anderen Nachweisanspruch'

mp_list.wird repr\u00e4sentiert durch: derives_into (e.g. XSD; proposed earlier as represented_by, named derives_into by ruling C21)

claim_types.gaps_vs_kernel: validated_by and accepted_by have no kernel type yet (represented_by became the kernel type derives_into, C21); proposed as additions, each declaring its evidence claim. MP B.3.2 plans 'Beziehungstypen als feste Liste' in the glossary; that list is not in MP.
claim_types.rule: relations are attributes of the existing relation layer, not a new layer (MP p.6 B.1; p.10 'Keine vierte Framework-Schicht')

artifact_types.baseline: BL, a set of pinned pointers (artifacts AND relations), BEL §5.3
artifact_types.implementation: external artifact (code, story); held in its own home, pointed to, never copied; NOT a projection (ELSTER §6)
artifact_types.derivative: artifact with a required mode: generated (validator, generated test, XSD/API schema, generated target code) or authored (written from pinned sources); manuals and handbooks may be either, with derives_from + preserves[]; NOT a projection (BEL §7.2, MP p.6, ELSTER Phase D; C21; manuals and mode: C21 Q6, Fabian 2026-10-27)

regulation_requirement.regulation: regulation corpustext label (DORA, NIS2, KRITIS-Dachgesetz, MaRisk, ISO 27001, ...)
regulation_requirement.duty_id: stable duty id within that regulation

projection_kinds.generated_representation: field catalogue (ELSTER §6). XSD/API schema, validators and generated tests moved to artifact_types.derivative (C21). Generated documentation (reference, API docs, field catalogue, rule and release docs) is a projection (BEL §5.2 Publikationssichten; C21 Q6). Manuals and handbooks are derivatives (artifact_types.derivative).
projection_kinds.board_view: list/kanban/timeline/story map (MAN artifacts; BEL §7 'vier Sichten auf denselben Bestand')
projection_kinds.aggregate: counts, status rollups, unread badges - must be computed or declared caches with drift check
projection_kinds.mirror: read-only display of an external artifact's content, always with source@version + regenerated, never edited

gates.invariant_gate: every gate first runs drift_check on the artifacts it touches; any violation blocks

checks: work item POINTS to the leading spec instead of restating it (MAN DoR)
all generated representations from the same spec version
implementation passes AC+tests of that version
production evidence points to released spec version

lifecycle.note: Each stage is a separate artifact connected by pointers; stages never restate the previous stage (IA §9 'ergaenzt den vorherigen Informationsstand, ohne ihn zu wiederholen').

derived_status.rule: Status is never set. No event type or verb writes a status; every status is a fold over events.
derived_status.ready: no open decision event on the subject + DoR
derived_status.verified: among the gate-accepted test verifications pinned to subject@v, the latest one per check (gate and method) decides: at least one passes and none fails. A later result replaces an earlier one of the same check only, so a pass on one check of a gate never hides a fail on another check of that gate. Sources: core_primitives projections.issue_view 'latest verification per check'; JWF p.10 QG 2 'Tests erfolgreich'; BEL p.22 'Über dieselbe fachliche Relation können mehrere, auch widersprüchliche Nachweise nebeneinander bestehen'. Fabian, 2026-10-19: per check, not per gate (Lean latestPerCheck)
derived_status.done: inclusion event (release/baseline) of subject@v AND a gate-accepted, passing verification pinned_against subject@v; a verification pinned to another version does not count

purpose_register.render_vs_verification: They overlap in how they are checked, not in what they preserve. In MP, verification is a purpose: which representations are indistinguishable for verification (MP p.8 C.1). MP does not list its invariants. MP B.2 names the invariants of an ELSTER field rule (Wertebereich, Pflicht/Optionalitaet, Kardinalitaet, Abhaengigkeitsbedingung), 'maschinell gegen XSD, Validator und Testabdeckung pruefbar', and the default profile assigns them to verification (a profile choice). render (agents-design calculus §8.2) preserves the element tree and the resolved token values of the output. The two invariant sets differ, and an output can keep one and drop the other, so render is neither verification nor a sub-case of it. The overlap: render, like the field rules, is checked by tests on the output, so its evidence is a verification event (stage test). That is the event kind, not the purpose. Keep both purposes, and do not read the purpose verification as anything checked by a verification event.
